speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (also known as Suboptimal Intake Jaundice). The clinical picture of a well-appearing, 2-week-old exclusively breastfed infant with worsening jaundice, normal vital signs, and no signs of sepsis or severe dehydration is classic for this condition.
